description: The ultimate upper-body bodyweight pulling movement for developing broad back and arm strength.
setup: Hang from an overhead bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width and arms completely straight.
steps: Initiate the pull by drawing shoulder blades down and back.
Pull elbows down toward your hips while driving chest up toward the bar.
Continue pulling until your chin clears the top edge of the bar.
Lower yourself under control back to a complete dead hang before initiating the next rep.
cues: Think of driving your elbows into your back pockets
Keep legs glued together and abs tight to prevent swinging

mistakes.mistake: Kicking legs or kipping hips to generate momentum
mistakes.fix: Keep core braced and body stiff from head to toe for strict reps

mistakes.mistake: Cutting the range of motion short at the top or bottom
mistakes.fix: Clear chin fully over the bar and reach full straight arm lockout at bottom

rep_standard: Begins from a dead hang with straight arms and locked elbows, requires chin clearly over the bar at the top, and returns to full extension without swinging.

poses.label: Top: chin clearly above the bar
